summary: A 48 dp row of equal-width tabs from a static list of labels: a tap sets `selected` to the tab's index (then runs any extra `onClick` actions). style underline (default) slides an underline under the selected tab; style segmented is a pill-shaped track whose filled pill slides to the selected option (a segmented control: Day / Week / Month). A screen reader hears each tab's label and Selected or Not selected, which follows the index at run time.

labels.doc: The tab labels, e.g. ["Day", "Week", "Month"]; each is also its tab's accessibility label

style.doc: underline: labels over a 2 dp underline that slides to the selected tab (a tab bar over panels). segmented: a pill-shaped @colors.surfaceHigh track, the selected option a filled `color` pill with an onPrimary label, the others onSurface (a segmented control, a view switcher). Mono: a filled white pill with black text on a black track ringed in grey

selected.doc: The selected index (0-based). Bind a document variable so panels can follow it; the bar animates the change itself (the underline or the pill slides, the labels cross-fade)

color.doc: underline: the selected label and the underline, unselected labels muted. segmented: the selected pill (its label is onPrimary)

onClick.doc: Extra actions run on every tab tap after `selected` is set, so they see the NEW index. To tell the app which tab: one action carrying the index, [{"type": "hostNamedAction", "name": "viewSelected", "value": "@sel", "valueType": "float"}] with "selected": "@sel" (json2rc declares a name used by several tabs once, so every tab sends it). Omitted: a tap only sets `selected`

pitfalls: labels is static: the tabs are generated when the document is built ($each), and their number is the local n ({"$count": "labels"}); the selection is the runtime part

The motion is an animated local s = {"value": "@selected", "anim": 0.25}: it eases to the new index at paint time, and everything visible reads s, not @selected (the tap still sets @selected at once, so panels can switch immediately)
Each tab's highlight is a second, coloured copy of its label over the plain one, with graphicsLayer alpha 1 - min(1, abs(s - i)): 1 on the selected tab, 0 elsewhere, a cross-fade while s moves

underline: one 2 dp canvas under the row, a rect from s * componentWidth() / n to (s + 1) * componentWidth() / n, so it slides between tabs. segmented: one canvas behind the row draws the pill the same way (a round rect inset 4 dp), so it slides too
Mono themes have no motion: s is @selected, the underline, the pill and the highlight jump
Show the matching panel with the same alpha expression on stacked panels (or visibility); the tab bar does not switch content by itself

`onClick` actions are appended to every tab's click list, after the valueFloatChange: a hostNamedAction carrying "@sel" (valueType float) sends the tapped index, and tapping the selected tab again sends it too. valueType is a json2rc extension: the Java JSON parser does not write the value

Accessibility: each tab carries its label (contentDescription), the state (stateDescription, Selected or Not selected) and the click; the whole 48 dp height of each tab is the touch target. The state is cut from "Not selectedSelected    " by textSubtext at 12 * (1 - min(1, abs(@selected - i))) and trimmed (as in Chip), in the global section of a 0-size canvas at the head of the bar, so it follows a bound variable at run time. About 120 B per tab, and the named text ops keep the call from compiling to a pattern
Segmented: each tab's tap area is the inset pill (padding 4, clip 20), so the press ripple stays inside the pill's rounded shape.
